note: Races 3 and 4 are both Wednesday. The event publishes no gun for either, but all three 9 September loggers record race windows at 12:55:00Z and 16:20:00Z to the second, so race 3 is read at 13:00Z and race 4 at 16:00Z — each about the midpoint of its first beat.
trend: The bias is not a constant and it does not decay smoothly either. It held near +18 degrees for three races — +19.1, +18.0, +17.7 — and then collapsed to +1.3 in the late afternoon of the second day. Correct with the most recent measurement, not a mean: the mean of +14.0 is wrong for every race in the series.
